name: e1-below-suppress
note: E1 of the ATTRIBUTION batch: oblique-below's geometry, unchanged, with Control/BelowAlignSuppress swept ABBA so one checkbox flies both arms. It asks whether the v0.85 roll-invariant below-nose suppression buys anything where the elDn defect lives - the regime that stands 6.92 deg of error at +-43 deg of bank while its LARGER upper mirror stands 0.03. PASS: with the suppression on, terminalOffDeg and rollYawOpposedPct on the below-nose segments come down against the off arm and the mirror pairs move closer together. FAIL: no separation between arms (the fix does nothing where it was aimed), or the on arm is worse. Read blendRailPct first - a railed segment is no signal, not a good score. Fly with DroneCount 1: the arm scheduler stands down when a second aircraft is mid-card. Its control is e1-below-control, same knob on the above-nose diamond. AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition.
